title: Te Reo i mua i te Āwhā
intro: I ara ake tētahi tangata i te koraha hei karanga i tētahi iwi kaha ki te pono. I mōhiotia te iwi mō ō rātou whare whakahīhī me te kaha kāore e taea te whakataurite. Heoi, nā tō rātou whakapehapeha rātou i matapo, ā, i kore ai rātou e whakarongo. I te mutunga, ka pā mai he whiu nui ki a rātou, ā, he iti noa iho te hunga whakapono i ora.
clues: I tonoa ahau ki tētahi iwi mana nui e noho ana i ngā whenua whānui, e mōhiotia ana hoki mō tō rātou mana.
I whaia e tōku iwi tētahi atu iwi nui kua whakangaromia.
He tino ataahua ā rātou hanganga, ā, he teitei hoki ō rātou pourewa i hanga.
I karanga ahau i a rātou kia karakia ki te Atua Kotahi, engari i whakakahore rātou ki te whakarērea ā rātou whakapakoko.
I tau te whiu kino ki runga i a rātou, ā, ko te hunga anake i whakapono tahi me ahau i whakaorangia.
Ko ahau te tangata i tonoa ki tētahi iwi nui e mōhiotia ana ko 'Ād'.

outcome.answer: I whakangaromia tōku iwi e te hau nui, ko ahau ia i whakaorangia

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
